2 تَدْرِيكٌ The dropping of rain with close consecutiveness, (IAar, K, TA,) as though one portion thereof overtook another. (IAar, TA.) You say, درّك المَطَرُ The rain dropped with close consecutiveness. (TK.) ―
-b2- Also The hanging a rope upon the neck of a person in coupling him with another. (AA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
